summary: Mobile Global Esports, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement and issuance of a $130,000 convertible promissory note (with $13,000 original issue discount) to an investor. The note bears 6% interest, matures April 28, 2027, and is convertible into common stock six months after issuance at 65% of the lowest trading price over the prior 15 days. The company may prepay at escalating premiums (110%–140%) within 180 days. This is a routine convertible debt financing, not a special situation.
